train_video_pose_model: train a VideoPose3D model on 2D pose detections with supervised or semi-supervised learning
evaluate_pose_predictions: evaluate 3D pose predictions using MPJPE, P-MPJPE, N-MPJPE, and velocity error protocols
render_pose_reconstruction: render a 3D pose reconstruction animation from 2D keypoints with ground truth comparison
fetch_pose_sequences: fetch 2D and 3D pose sequences filtered by subject, action, and camera from the dataset
run_action_evaluation: run per-action evaluation of 3D pose predictions across all test subjects and actions
